# Incident review: search outage, 14 March

## What happened

At 09:12 GMT the search service in the London data centre began returning empty results for roughly 40% of queries. The on-call engineer was paged at 09:15 and recognised the pattern from a similar incident in November. Service was fully restored at 09:51.

## Cause

A nightly cron job that rebuilds the product catalogue index ran forty minutes late because of a slow upstream export. It was still writing the new index when the morning traffic peak began, and the search nodes analysed the half-written file as if it were complete. The behaviour was not an error in the indexer; the job simply assumed it would finish before anyone was awake.

## Actions

- Write the index to a temporary file and rename it atomically when complete.

- Alert if the catalogue job has not finished by 06:00.

- Add the November incident and this one to the runbook so the pattern is documented.
